language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the wooden spoon and closes its fingers around its handle at frames 78–94 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), then visibly lifts and carries it at frames 105–137 (image, left_ego_image). At frames 175–197, the spoon remains held outside the drawer; no release into the drawer is visible (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image). Completion is therefore unconfirmed in the observed episode, rather than a visibly failed grasp or placement attempt. The approach, acquisition, and subsequent transport do not establish a local failure.
